Treat usage and resource measures as diagnostic evidence, not agent scores or adoption targets. observation.source_interface: MNCS Debug native process integration test and standard-library resolution

outcome.consumer_surface: MNCS Debug declares replay_process with effect process_run authorized_by debug_process and invokes it through its native core.
outcome.observed_limitation: Before the resolver change, the targeted consumer integration test failed during compilation because the extracted mncs-stdlib root and mncs-language/library mirror both supplied the mncs.std.process.v1 module identity.
outcome.environmental_pressure: The consumer had a native process capability and an existing integration test, but automatic library-root discovery supplied duplicate standard-library module identities and prevented the consumer from compiling.
outcome.agent_impact: not-established; the observed failure came from an explicitly run integration test, not a recorded agent attempt
outcome.causal_scope: The duplicate module roots explain this compile failure; the evidence does not establish broader agent impact or recurrence.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Duplicate standard-library roots block MNCS Debug's native process consumer
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The pre-change Debug resolver automatically included both the extracted stdlib and mncs-language/library. The targeted process integration test then failed to compile on the duplicate mncs.std.process.v1 identity.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Use the extracted stdlib as the sole automatic standard-library root when it is present, retain the language-tree fallback when it is absent, and preserve explicit MNCS_LIBRARY_PATH additions.
not_measured: whether an agent encountered this failure outside the targeted integration test
